name: genericmed-root
description: genericMed Enterprise Healthcare Marketplace Monorepo Root

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'backend'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'frontend'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
